findings.rationale: BMI lower tail collapses to about 0 (p01 near 0, versus a federation median p01 of 18.16) and the BMI mean is about half the median, which fits roughly half of BMI values being a 0 sentinel rather than missing. PhysHlth has a p99 near 73 against a median of 30. The same pattern is present at round 1, so the artefact is from the start. The local model is also weaker and under-predicts: AUC 0.73 and CITL -0.048, with the prevalence itself normal. The update screen shows only a mild cosine outlier (min_cos z=-3.3), which is secondary.

BMI lower tail is at or below 0 (p01 -0.17 at round 20, -0.55 at round 1) and the BMI mean is about half the median, consistent with a 0 sentinel for missing values. PhysHlth p99 is about 74. The artefact is present from round 1. The local model is weaker (AUC 0.74, CITL -0.050) with normal prevalence, and its false-negative rates are elevated in both sex subgroups.

BMI lower tail is near 0 (p01 0.58 at round 20, -0.11 at round 1) with a BMI mean of about 13, roughly half the median, which fits a 0 sentinel. PhysHlth p99 is about 67-74. The artefact is present from round 1. The local model is weaker (AUC 0.755, CITL -0.038) with normal prevalence.

report.summary: Screened all 52 clients with the all-client views of the update, performance, drift, feature and subgroup tools, then confirmed leads with narrower queries. Three clients (AZ, KS, MT) show a consistent missing-artefact signature from round 1: BMI lower tails at or near 0 where the federation median is about 18, BMI means roughly half the median, and PhysHlth tails near 73. Each also has a weaker local AUC (0.73-0.76) and a negative CITL with normal prevalence. Other leads were judged to be noise: the drift readings for GU and VI jump erratically from round to round at their small sample sizes; the CT AgeGroup-1 outlier (outcome rate 1.0) did not reproduce on re-query; and the remaining single outliers (DE HighBP p99, WY Sex mean, NH Income-2 outcome rate, GU Stroke, AK/ME/MI AgeGroup subgroups) were weak (|z_noise| about 3-4) with no second tool confirming them. No poisoning, free-rider or explanation-instability pattern appeared in the update norms or cosines once client size was accounted for. The full 20.0 budget was spent.
